description: Hugging Face flagship Claude Solace. Sized so the BF16 checkpoint plus KV cache fits under a 32 GB RAM budget while packing as many parameters as that budget allows. Same hybrid Gemma-4 + GPT-OSS architecture as the smaller variants, scaled.

deployment.notes: Primary HF artifact is BF16 safetensors. At 8k ctx total runtime memory is ~26 GB; at 131k ctx ~30 GB thanks to sliding-window KV bounding for 5/6 of layers. A Q5_K_M GGUF and a bnb-int8 build are recommended companions for users near the 32 GB ceiling.
